zh: BaoCode 现可将指定桌面会话连接到 Edge 侧栏。侧栏使用一次性连接码，可继续同一条会话并查看回复；无需共享网页。请单独安装 Edge 扩展 0.3.1；此更新不发布扩展商店版本。
en: Connect a selected desktop conversation to the BaoCode Edge sidebar with a one-time code. Continue the same chat and view replies without sharing the web page. Install the 0.3.1 extension separately; this update does not publish a browser store version.
